name: btn: Create Opportunity
purpose: Button on the opportunity screens: clears the selector party, installs a one-second timer that will create the opportunity after the user finishes, and opens the Create Party card flagged as a lead. The opportunity itself is created later by the timer script.
calls:
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/615 "OnTimer: Handle Create Opportunity" (step 6; Install OnTimer Script)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/184 "Open Create Party Card" (step 8; Perform Script)
open_question: Starts a two-script flow (timer script 615 continues it). The lead flag is passed as LeadInd true.

name: btn: Create Opportunity From Party
purpose: Button on the customer layouts: builds a JSON with the current party's Id, calls the controller's #wip Create Opportunity, shows an error dialog (and returns -2) when it fails, otherwise opens the new opportunity in a card. The opportunity record is written by the controller script; the effect owner of that part is server-domain.
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/602 "#wip Create Opportunity { json }" (step 4; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/611 "Go to Opportunity Card { Id }" (step 15; Perform Script)
open_question: The called controller script is named with a #wip prefix. Returns 1 on success and -2 on error; callers on the layouts probably ignore the result.

name: Go to Opportunity Card { Id }
purpose: Opens the Opportunity Detail card in a new window and finds the opportunity whose Id is in the script parameter. There is no check that the find returned a record.
open_question: No error check after Perform Find (step 9); Go to Next Field (step 11) has no clear purpose. includeInMenu is on.

name: btn: Change Opportunity Status
purpose: Button in the status popover: commits the record, sends the controller's #wip Update Opportunity Status the opportunity Id, the chosen status id and today's date as EndDate, and shows an error dialog when it fails. The status change itself is written by the controller script (effect owner: server-domain).
calls: karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/608 "#wip Update Opportunity Status { json }" (step 9; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
open_question: EndDate is always today's date, whatever status is chosen; confirm the controller decides whether an end date applies. The called script has a #wip prefix.

name: btn: Add Contact to Opportunity
purpose: Button that commits the current opportunity and opens the Create Party card for a contact, passing the opportunity's organization id, name and match id and marking the organization as prescribed.
calls: karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/184 "Open Create Party Card" (step 11; Perform Script)
open_question: No timer or follow-up script is installed, so this script does not link the new contact to the opportunity; check how the Create Party card finishes the link. $params is built from an unset variable. Step 6 (SkipOrganizationInd) is disabled.

name: OnTimer: Handle Create Opportunity
purpose: Timer handler that finishes the create-opportunity flow: stops the timer, reads the lead role id and the organization (or person) chosen on the Create Party card, finds the current user's employee party role as salesperson, sends them to the controller's #wip Create Opportunity, shows an error dialog (-2) on failure, and otherwise opens the opportunity detail. The record is created by the controller script (effect owner: server-domain).
reads:
UtilityParty::PartyRoleId#39 (step 5)
UtilityParty::OrganizationId#20, UtilityParty::PersonId#21 (step 6)
session::CurrentUserPartyId#63 (step 7)
Party_PartyRole::Id#16 (SQL.GetColumn2Fields step 8, where Party_PartyRole::PartyId#45 = user party and Party_PartyRole::EmployeeInd#43 = 1)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/602 "#wip Create Opportunity { json }" (step 16; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/603 "Go to Opportunity Detail { Id }" (step 25; Perform Script)
open_question: $StartDate (step 15) is never set in this script, so StartDate is sent empty. $SalespersonId is replaced by the Party_PartyRole id and goes empty when the user has no employee role. Exits quietly when no party was chosen. includeInMenu is on.

name: btn: Add New File as FileAttachment to Opportunity
purpose: Button in the opportunity attachments portal: builds a FileAttachment JSON that targets the opportunity (entity type 13) and its party (type 10) and calls Add File to pick and store a file.
open_question: The file record and attachments are written by Add File (642); entity type codes 13 and 10 are hard-coded.

name: btn: Download and Open File from Opportunity
purpose: Button that exports the attachment's container field to a file named by the script parameter in the temporary folder and opens it with the default application.
external: Export Field Contents (step 5; writes the container to Get(TemporaryPath) & filename and opens it)
open_question: The file name comes from the script parameter and is appended to the temp path without any check; create folders is off.

name: btn: Delete FileAttachment from Opportunity
purpose: Button in the attachments portal: calls the controller's Delete FileAttachment with the attachment Id and AttachmentId, shows an error dialog (-2) on failure, commits and refreshes the portal. The delete is done by the controller script (effect owner: server-domain).
calls: karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/612 "Delete FileAttachment { data }" (step 5; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
open_question: Which records the controller deletes (link only, or the file as well) is not visible here.

name: Button: Assign Referring Party
purpose: Button for the Referred By field: installs a one-second timer for the result handler, computes where to place the picker card from the layout object ReferredByParty, and opens the Contact Picker from the Picker Module for a single selection with create allowed.
calls:
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/722 "Timer: Handle Assign Referring Party" (step 4; Install OnTimer Script)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/67 "Show Contact Picker( { top { ; left { ; allowMultiple } } } )" (step 23; Perform Script; data source Picker_Module.fmp12)
open_question: Returns 1 immediately; the picked party is handled later by the timer script 722. Picker parameters are hard-coded (single select, any party type).

name: Timer: Handle Assign Referring Party
purpose: Timer handler for the referring-party picker: runs the common contact-handler tests, ends the timer when a pick was made or the user cancelled, and copies the first picked party's Id and name onto the current opportunity as ReferringPartyId and ReferringPartyNameCached.
writes:
Opportunity::ReferringPartyId#65 (Set Field step 38, current record)
Opportunity::ReferringPartyNameCached#66 (Set Field step 39, current record)
calls: karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/63 "Contact Handler Common Tests" (step 7; Perform Script)
open_question: Only the first picked party is used. The timer keeps polling while no pick exists (it is removed only on cancel or on a pick). The record is not committed in this script. The name is a cached copy written by the client. includeInMenu is on. Depends on Contact Handler Common Tests (63), not read here.

name: Button: Show Active and Sort by Status
purpose: Finds opportunities that are active (ActiveInd = 1) and sorts them by cached status then name, keeping the sort.
reads:
Opportunity::ActiveInd#59 (find criterion step 2; value 1)
Opportunity::StatusCached#50 (sort key step 4, ascending)
Opportunity::Name#69 (sort key step 4, ascending)
open_question: Definition of active lives in Opportunity::ActiveInd (calculation not read here). includeInMenu is on. Same find as the initial find in script 767.

name: btn: End Party Relationship from Opportunity_deprecated
purpose: Button inside the opportunity party-relation portal (marked deprecated in its name): sends the controller's Edit Party Relation the opportunity's party as PartyFrom, the portal row's party as PartyTo, CurrentInd false and ThruDate today, then commits. The relation is changed by the controller script (effect owner: server-domain).
calls: karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/508 "Edit Party Relation { data }" (step 5; Perform Script; data source karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
open_question: Name says deprecated but the Opportunity Detail layout still references it. The result of the controller call is not checked. Relies on portal context. includeInMenu is on.
